question: Can the measured acceleration of the actual links, rather than the acceleration of the taught path, recover the placing-phase net vertical external wrench from public motor encoder and JTS alone?
method: Ring of 31 per-link dynamic residuals using reconstructed elastic angle, central 3-sample kinematics and public rigid full-payload inverse dynamics. A fixed zero-end quartic weak-form window cancels encoder second differences; do not differentiate the current sample or use future samples. Use the Jacobian virtual displacement for 1 m vertical translation and zero rotation, allowing other force and moment components. Signed and unrectified. Public one-cycle-delayed sensor is paired with preceding encoder, deconvolved with known 300 Hz pole, then inverted through nominal spring-damper. Estimated force refers to 17 cycles before availability. Nominal small deflection uncertainty and unknown actual grasp are limitations.
bias: Component median of the filtered empty-arm ID minus JTS between 0.075 and 0.425 s of the ungripped phase, no table or collision labels. Does not assume motion follows the taught acceleration. Remains frozen thereafter. Not a detector.

window.weight: (1-x^2)^2 for x in [-1,1] normalized by sum; fixed

pairs: 3 distinct positive masses/COM/seeds; both servo/torque; baseline R10 and frozen R11 velocity prototype for a nontrivial variation in actual force; nominal, parameter perturbation and pickup offset. 12 unforced actual episodes, none used to set weights or criteria. No new mode selection based on results.

gates.coverage: all required force targets available; after grip change or ill-conditioned posture return unavailable, never zero. Report the entire final20 for same-time scores. Misattribution cannot be guaranteed in external impacts.
gates.lagged: 12/12 within 0.15 box weight RMSE vs identically weighted solver force over approach; pooled RMSE <= 0.75 of the current public projected-support value at the output time. Compare also to zero and an explicit legacy target-clock control.
gates.now: Do NOT drive load feedback unless last20 mean absolute same-time error <=0.12 box weight in every case, and no current-time false confidence (true <0.25 and predicted >=0.50) on the approach. Separately report unfiltered/current vs delayed target error. No smoothing true signal for same-time scoring.

conditional: Only if both physical observer gates pass, freeze and try a strictly limited independent feedback implementation. Otherwise no use as a current table sensor, no tweaking the kernel/bias on this data. A later separate method may use identified public geometry or prediction but cannot relabel a measured result.
boundaries: True table force, plant pose/velocity, actuation and collision/detector output are evaluation-only. Not table-specific during another contact, not a hardware sensor, not hard realtime. No gain, detector, entrypoint, simulation or evaluator modification.
